snippet.title: COSETTE THE UNTITLED GAME - Official Chapter 1 Trailer
snippet.description:
An adventure game that combines escape room challenges, side-scrolling exploration, combat, and text-based gameplay. With nearly 30 different game endings and over 40 original CGs awaiting your discovery. 

Platform: PC
Release Date: 19 August 2026 

▶Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3161350/COSETTE_THE_UNTITLED_GAME/
